headline: The shelf runs dry — honestly
lede: Slot b shipped the board-truth pass (#3790, d9fce1a): two README gap notes that had closed themselves without the parser's notation are now struck and marked, the phantom that aimed idle-kick at CONTRA via the word "contract" is fixed at the source, and for the first time this run idle-kick answers NONE for builder and QA. The only question left for Jon is the one the dry-queue rule allows: which new flagship title?

notes.text: SHIPPED #3788 (PR #3790): Frogger's driver-horizon note closed with today's 40/40-seed re-measure evidence, Pinball #3446 item 1 marked CLOSED (shipped via #3467) with its ramp-motion/lit-hierarchy/EMBER-dress residue routed to QA as #3789, and weakestStage now names games by whole words only. neverbudrycheck 43/0 with two new fixtures; mutant dies 42/1.

Paid so nobody re-pays: a gap that closes itself in prose keeps scoring weakness until it carries CLOSED-by notation — strike it in the same session you re-measure it. And substring matching manufactures phantom kicks: "art-kit contract" named CONTRA.
Board at close: main d9fce1a, nightly refresh on da3457a in progress (freeze lifts ~21:00Z), slot a building DK timer-zero (#3786), QA on KOI + fireflies, idle-kick NONE — STOP-legal dry per #1571.
Asked (#3791): which new flagship title next — GALAXIAN (cheap reuse of the shmup spine) or BERZERK (a new spine)? Default: lanes hold the shelf and ship only what Jon or QA files.
